text:
very bearish on telling ppl "its gonna be alright"

or sending tweets like "good morning, every last one of u out there is gonna be just fine"

what a chickenshit message. why would u blindly dispense pernicious advice like that

most of the time, its actually not going to be fine

it could be fine, assuming that u quit being a lazy bum and go make something happen

but if u just sit there? I can almost guarantee it won't be fine

so its thoughtless to go around, meddling in the affairs of the divine, breeding a false sense of complacency in people

by the numbers, most people aren't going to be fine

they'll be alive, at least for today

but every American is either drunk, high, on uppers, on downers, or all of the above... perpetually

do you do that when you're fine?

or do you do it to numb yourself to reality, to run away from yourself, to desperately try and escape whatever pain and suffering currently ails you?

a true friend would probably wake u up by telling u something like,

"good morning. u are fucked"

u are absolutely not gonna be alright, brethren

why do I say that, I have no idea, but I know its an accurate statement

whether it be the aroma of dreams deferred, or the silent tiptoe of death gaining on u... biding his time, perhaps deciding to pounce a few decades earlier than u expected, who knows

"but I saw a tweet that said I'd be fine"

u fell victim to a malevolent tweet my son

however, I come bearing good news

you may actually be just fine today

most of the problems u woke up with, u will solve...doing all the little things right, getting that much closer to ur goals and ur dreams, full of light and fulfillment and love, feeling the presence of God.

that could be ur day. it could be ur every day

but if u dont do anything? 

none of this shit happens

that's why I came here specifically to tell you

"good morning, hermano"

ur day sucks right now, and unless u do something about it, the rest of ur day will remain that way.

now get off ur ass and go make shit happen. 

and if anyone tweets at you about how ur gonna be just fine...make sure u do the right thing, and gently remind them just how fucked they really are.
